kind: OPENROUTER LIVE INFERENCE (AI Executive Team, synthetic store data)
note: OpenRouter is not AMD infrastructure; this evidence does not count toward the AMD or Gemma-on-AMD requirement.
request: Our business is underperforming. I want my AI executive team to investigate the reasons, propose the highest-impact improvements and identify operational actions we can safely automate.

result.request: Our business is underperforming. I want my AI executive team to investigate the reasons, propose the highest-impact improvements and identify operational actions we can safely automate.

findings.text: Net revenue declined by 58,460 USD from April to September 2026 (309,620 → 251,160).
Gross margin percentage fell 5.86 points from 43.3% to 37.44% over the same period.
Refunds as share of gross sales rose 4.29 points from 3% to 7.29%, contributing -2.76 pct pts to margin decline and representing $11,610 excess refund cost.
Customer acquisition cost increased 11.39 USD per new customer (18.95 → 30.34) while marketing spend rose 18,000 USD (36,000 → 54,000).
Cost-related factors accounted for -3.1 pct pts of the margin decline, indicating rising COGS or other cost pressures.

recommendations.action: Launch a refund reduction initiative (improve product descriptions, tighten quality control, streamline returns process).
Review supplier contracts and production efficiencies to lower COGS.
Optimize marketing mix and targeting to reduce CAC while maintaining volume.

missingInformation: Detailed COGS breakdown to identify specific cost drivers.
Refund reason codes (defects, mismatch, buyer remorse, etc.) to target corrective actions.
Customer lifetime value or repeat purchase rate to assess the impact of higher CAC on profitability.
